# Blueprint [change name]

## Intent
<!--  What the user wants to achieve.  -->

## Decisions
<!-- Important choices and why they were chosen. Also record ambiguities that were resolved and design corrections from the user, so future agents see the decision history and don't repeat past mistakes. -->

## Flow
<!-- Optional. Use when data, state, or control flow changes meaningfully. Keep it simple but explanatory: show the flow as short labeled steps joined with ASCII `->`; put important branches or outcomes in parentheses or indented continuation lines. Do not use Mermaid or elaborate box diagrams. Multiple diagrams if multiple flows. -->
- [A] -> [B] -> (branch C -> [Outcome]; branch D -> [Outcome]) -> [E]

## Gotchas
<!-- Optional. Non-obvious traps, risks, tradeoffs, fragile areas, or surprising exceptions future agents must not miss. -->

## Contracts
<!-- Must-hold outcomes for verification. Keep short, no need for WHEN+THEN and similar.-->

## Out of scope
<!-- Where this feature stops. Deferred items should go to `backlog.md`, not here. -->

## Existing Foundation
<!-- what's already built, what can be reused as-is, what's a near miss worth tweaking, what overlaps to avoid, integration points, patterns to follow -->
